title: NRS attestation trust root
description: Meta-schema for registries/attestation-trust-root.yaml: the pinned public keys that make a signature nomue-attested (NRS-ATTEST-0007) and their generation transitions (NRS-ATTEST-0008). keys may be empty (pre-ceremony state); entries are append-only and leave service by supersession, never deletion.

fingerprint_method.$comment: Human-readable statement of the fingerprint computation; the reference implementation pins SHA-256 over DER-encoded SPKI, lowercase hex with a sha256: prefix.

key_id.$comment: Opaque identifier carried by signature.key_id; the trailing number is the generation.

suite_id.$comment: Must reference an adopted suite in registries/attestation-signature-suites.yaml (cross-checked by pnpm validate).

public_key_pem.$comment: SPKI PEM as exported by the custody platform (Cloud KMS get-public-key).

valid_until.$comment: null = open-ended until superseded; overlapping windows across generations are legitimate during transitions (NRS-ATTEST-0008).
